title: Splitting Sets Under Differential-Transcendental Extensions
exact_gap: No arbitrary-pair Turing reduction in the omitted base classes; in particular the differentially closed-base branch lacks high-order specializations. The constant-base primitive-element repair is not promoted without auditing the separate algebraic-dependence-oracle dependency.
strongest_self_contained_partial_result: For every ordinary characteristic-zero K and differentially transcendental z, (delta Y - a z, 1) is constrained over K<z> exactly when a != 0.
uniformity: Canonical computable rational-jet presentation; effective embedding into ambient field; differential transcendence is a promise, not tested. Family classification uses only equality in K.
